rationale: O'Kelly et al. define their target as accident probability under a base distribution of standard traffic behavior and call estimating that base distribution essential. Their simulation result is therefore conditional on the traffic distribution, simulator inputs and selected risk metric. No inspected material converts this research estimator into unconditional safety proof from accumulated test miles, so the scoped claim survives.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-003-R1, O'Kelly et al., 'Scalable End-to-End Autonomous Vehicle Testing via Rare-event Simulation', PDF p. 1
S-EVID-003-R2, O'Kelly et al., PDF p. 2, base-distribution and simulation-input discussion
limitations: The reviewed work is a 2019 research preprint for a highway scenario, not a regulatory method or DAA validation.
The scenario generator, tail assumptions, perception rendering, threshold and estimator were not independently validated here.
